resource.name: internal-payments-api
resource.description: A payment processing service that handles charges, refunds, and payment status for any project needing to process payments.

config.description: Base URL of the internal payments API (e.g. https://development-default.apps.94.72.97.95.sslip.io/internal-payments-api).

resource.consumptionInstructions: Call the service directly at its base URL — it requires no credential or authentication header, and is reachable over the public internet. Read the base URL from the PAYMENT_API_BASE_URL config key rather than hardcoding it, and follow the operations defined in its OpenAPI contract for charging, refunding, and checking payment status.
